name: 33433 · Boca Raton, FL
findings: ZIP 33433 (Boca Raton) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33433 (Boca Raton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33433 (Boca Raton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
